svg.title: From Vetted Seat to Repeatable High-Ticket Close
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-closer-seat-to-repeatable-close; chapter number: 1; title: From Vetted Seat to Repeatable High-Ticket Close; subtitle: Commission-only closing on $3K-$25K offers over Zoom; caption: Closers vet the owner first, win the seat with high-volume outreach, screen applications for cash on hand, run pain-first discovery, and judge results weekly against a 30-40% close-rate floor.; assumptions note: Sequence assembled from practitioner operator gates and pro-tips. Figures are attributed claims, including Cosper's 10% closer, 5% setter, and 15% self-set split with refund clawbacks.; note: Sources include Colby Lyman, Frankie Isaac, Hudson Cosper, Scale Like ZK, Daniel Coutts, and Daniel Botero.; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Vet the Owner and Offer; value: Step 1; detail: Ask how many reps there are, what reps make, and how long the program has run, and request case studies (Colby Lyman). Treat fewer than 20 calls a week as a flag (Frankie Isaac). Reject pay-to-apply roles, tickets under 2K, and '10K guaranteed' pitches (Hudson Cosper).; step: 02; label: Win the Seat With Outreach; value: Step 2; detail: Run 100 DMs a day and 60-second Looms. Isaac's student Lucas landed nine interviews from 30 Looms, and another student, Adam, earned $9K in month one.; step: 03; label: Screen Cash on Hand; value: Step 3; detail: Ask about cash on hand in the application. A '$500' answer means cancel the call or offer a low-ticket downsell instead of burning a closer slot (Scale Like ZK).; step: 04; label: Run Pain-First Discovery; value: Step 4; detail: Run 30-45 minute diagnostic calls before any pitch. Probe each objection with what, why, and how, because every objection is a smokescreen (Daniel Coutts).; step: 05; label: Close and Track Weekly KPIs; value: Step 5; detail: Hold a 30-40% close-rate minimum against a 70-80% target on 5-10 calls a day (Hudson Cosper). Check KPIs weekly, because a bad show rate alone can turn $50K into $5K (Scale Like ZK).

rect.title: step: 01; label: Vet the Owner and Offer; value: Step 1; detail: Ask how many reps there are, what reps make, and how long the program has run, and request case studies (Colby Lyman). Treat fewer than 20 calls a week as a flag (Frankie Isaac). Reject pay-to-apply roles, tickets under 2K, and '10K guaranteed' pitches (Hudson Cosper).
